visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Last Column Is Missing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Transposing a 2 by 3 matrix should give 3 rows, [[1,4],[2,5],[3,6]], but the program prints only 2 rows.

solution.explanation: The new matrix has one row for every column of the old one, so the outer loop runs up to the length of a row (m[0].length), not the number of rows. The two only agree for square matrices.
